request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the two candle numbers described: no other candles, cards, signs, clocks, screens or clothes show any digit.

Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Two real children, a sister and a brother, sit side by side at a light wooden table in a bright, tidy family living room, both smiling at the camera. In front of each child is their own small round white birthday cake on a white plate, and on each cake stand two large, thick number candles, each candle as tall as the child's hand, with a small flame. Each child's cake is directly in front of that child. The candle numbers face the camera, are upright, sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. The older child is clearly older and taller than the younger one. Nothing else is on the table.

On the LEFT sits a girl with shoulder-length dark hair in a plain yellow T-shirt, about fourteen years old; the two blue number candles on her cake read 14 (a 1 and a 4, side by side). On the RIGHT sits a boy with short dark hair in a plain light-blue T-shirt, about eleven years old; the two red number candles on his cake read 11 (a 1 and a 1, side by side). The children sit close together, shoulder to shoulder, near the middle of the photo, each one's cake right in front of them, the two cakes a hand's width apart.
